release: R1 watchlist + R2 assisted execution + R3 keeper exits + R4 bounded automatic entries (opt-in, alpha, ahead of the research gate).
cadence: GitHub Actions: samples every 5 minutes inside a ~28-minute loop, started twice an hour; swap logs scanned forward every sample and backfilled within a per-run budget.

checks.label: Enough fresh data
checks.why: Signals only use completed hourly candles. Too little or stale data means no entry.

checks.label: Stronger than MON (medium term)
checks.why: The asset priced in MON must be higher than it was a week ago. Strength is measured against MON, not dollars.

checks.label: Fast trend above slow trend
checks.why: The 24-hour average price must be above the 72-hour average.

checks.label: Breaking out
checks.need: close within 0.5% of the prior 48 h high, or above
checks.why: The latest close must be at, or near, the highest close of the last two days.

checks.label: Not overextended
checks.why: Skip entries that already ran far above their average: they often snap back.

checks.label: Volatility acceptable
checks.why: Skip assets that swing too much against MON for the loss-exit trigger to be meaningful.

checks.label: Liquidity at your size
checks.why: A fresh buy quote and the matching sell quote at your size must lose little to the pool.

checks.label: Wrapper price healthy
checks.why: The pool price must match the price implied by USDC pools. A gap can mean a bridge or pool problem.

checks.label: Entry + estimated exit cost
checks.why: Swap costs plus gas for buying and selling back, as a share of the position.
